title: Power Automate: desktop flow libraries of reusable subflows
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and keeps library licensing, permissions, update behaviour and controls explicitly unresolved. The documented template comparisons are supported; three general desktop-flow premises need their supporting Microsoft references added.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe desktop flow libraries.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify publication or consumption access rules beyond identifying makers.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The required Power Automate for desktop version for libraries is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" publish edit consume permissions environments prerequisites version. Read roadmap and templates; reviewed version-control results. The template prerequisite is not a library prerequisite; none found for libraries.

claims.claim: Desktop flow templates are a separately documented capability for reusing and standardising automation logic.
claims.quote: A desktop flow template helps makers reuse and standardize automation logic across multiple desktop flows.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: A desktop flow created from a template is an independent copy.
claims.quote: A flow created from a template is an independent copy of that template.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Publishing an updated template does not update existing flows created from it.
claims.quote: Publishing an updated template makes the updated version available for future flows. Existing flows created from the template aren't updated.

claims.claim: No reviewed source says the introduction of libraries changes existing behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" "Power Platform" "pac" availability rollout. Read roadmap and four cited Learn pages; reviewed release-note results. No library-related change to existing behaviour stated.

claims.claim: Desktop automation actions may use connectors.
claims.quote: In desktop flows, you can utilize not only the standard set of actions available in the action library but also some of the most popular connectors.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/desktop-flows/how-to/use-connector-actions to sources for the general connector-action premise; retain the explicit uncertainty about library credentials.
